info.title: What is protected?
info.board: The Board is {public}: everyone who can reach this server can read it, and the server stores it in plain text.
info.encrypted: Encrypted channels are encrypted on your device with a key derived from the channel name and passphrase. The server only stores ciphertext.
info.protects: passive Wi-Fi sniffing and anyone reading the server's disk.
info.notProtects: an active attacker who can modify this page's code on plain HTTP (for example a rogue hotspot). Put Fyr behind HTTPS (a reverse proxy) for that.
info.anyone: Anyone with the passphrase can read everything and post under any nickname; nicknames and device tags are not verified.
info.weak: A weak passphrase can be guessed offline by someone who captures the channel id. Use 4+ random words.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.body: A backup contains settings, POI files, the curated catalog, download history and all messages (the Board and encrypted channels, which stay encrypted). Maps, books, models and other large content are not included; copy the data folder for those. Keep backups private.
backup.restoreBody: Restoring replaces settings, the curated catalog and POI files with the same names right away (other POI files are kept). Messages and download history are replaced when Fyr restarts.
backup.restart: Restart Fyr (for Docker: {command}) to finish restoring {items}. Until then the old messages stay in use.
backup.confirm:
Restore "{name}"?

This replaces the current settings, curated catalog and matching POI files now, and all messages and download history after the next restart. Take a backup first if you may want them back.
